about: EV charging specs for the cost per km on the maps of blokvolt.rs and evolako.rs (06.10.2026). cons_kwh_100km — consumption from the battery (trip computer), mixed driving at 15–25 °C, an estimate; winter_factor — multiplier at about 0 °C; dc_avg_10_80_kw — average DC power from 10 to 80 % (P3 = measured, calc = from the stated time, est = estimate); ac_amps — current per phase; ac_opt — the optional factory on-board charger. Fields listed in "est" are estimates. Attribution when published: "Open EV Data (https://github.com/KilowattApp/open-ev-data)" and © 2019 Chargeprice (MIT). Do not use ev-database.org (its terms forbid automated collection).
